title: Local finite-sum normal form in a coproduct of module sheaves
statement: Let C be a small category with pullbacks and K a precoverage satisfying [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let R be a sheaf of rings, with abelian sheafification and locally bijective equivalences, so that module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] exists. Let I be a small set with decidable equality, H_i sheaves of R-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and Q their chosen coproduct [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with insertions ι_i and coordinate retractions π_i. For every object V and section x∈Q(V), there is a small covering family a_α:U_α→V belonging to K and finite sets B_α⊆I such that x|U_α=∑_{i∈B_α}ι_i(π_i(x|U_α)). Empty index types and empty covering families are allowed.

proof.text: Form the coproduct P of the underlying module presheaves. By the sectionwise-colimit theorem, evaluation carries P to the coproduct of modules, identified with their direct sum. Each element t is the sum of its finitely many support coordinates.

proof.text: The module-sheafification adjunction identifies the sheafification of P with Q by the coproduct universal property, compatibly with insertions. The comparison P→Q is the sheafification unit followed by an isomorphism. Its underlying abelian-presheaf map is locally surjective, since the sheafification unit is.

proof.text: Refine the covering image sieve of x to a K-covering presieve. This refinement property follows by induction on the generated Grothendieck topology: generating covers and maximal sieves have refinements, pullbacks use the covering-pullback axiom, and transitivity uses bind composition. Write the presieve as a small family and choose on each arrow a preimage in P. Its finite support and the sectionwise direct-sum identity give a finite-sum expression for the restricted x.

source.place: Tag 03DB, lemma-limits-colimits and its proof (module-sheaf coproduct is the sheafification of the sectionwise coproduct); explicit image in the sectionwise product.

proof.text: Apply each coordinate retraction to this expression. In its own summand it is the identity, and on every other summand it is zero. Hence each coefficient in the support equals the corresponding retraction of the restricted x. Substitute these coefficients into the finite sum. This proves the stated normal form, including the empty direct sum and empty covering cases.

theorem moduleSheaf_coproduct_localGeneration
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (K : Precoverage C)
    (hK : K.IsSiteForCoverings) [HasPullbacks C]
    (R : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck RingCat.{r})
    [HasSheafify K.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [K.toGrothendieck.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (I : Type u) [DecidableEq I] (H : I → ringedSiteModules.{u} R)
    (V : C) (s : (∐ H).val.obj (op V)) :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (U : A → C) (a : ∀ α : A, U α ⟶ V),
      Presieve.ofArrows U a ∈ K V ∧
      ∃ B : A → Finset I, ∀ α : A,
        (∐ H).val.map (a α).op s =
          ∑ i ∈ B α, (Sigma.ι H i).val.app (op (U α))
            ((Sigma.π H i).val.app (op (U α)) ((∐ H).val.map (a α).op s))
